title: Quality management, supplier audits and CAPA | Aquemi
meta: How our QMS controls documents, changes, NCRs, suppliers and calibration, mapped to ISO 9001:2015. Request a supplier audit or questionnaire pack.
headline: Audit our quality system before you award the contract
lead: Your quality unit has to qualify us as a supplier. Here is how our quality management system (QMS) works, the record each process leaves, and how to audit it. [ISO 9001 status, registrar and expiry]

blocks.h: Our quality processes and the record each leaves
blocks.intro: An auditor picks a weld, a certificate or a change and asks how it was controlled. Each process leaves a record; where your quality agreement asks more, it governs.
rows: Document control
Numbered, approved documents; only the current revision is issued, superseded ones withdrawn and kept
Document register; client comment logs
Change control
Changes after approval assessed for impact and approved before work continues; changes to documents you approved need your approval
Change request with impact assessment; change control register
Nonconformance, CAPA and complaints
Nonconforming items held and dispositioned; repeat, systemic and client-reported causes get a corrective and preventive action (CAPA)
Nonconformance report (NCR); CAPA with effectiveness check; complaint log
Supplier control
Product-contact and special-process suppliers approved before use and reviewed on a schedule
Approved supplier list; incoming inspection records
Identification and traceability
Every product-contact component traced by heat, lot or serial number to its weld and drawing
Material log against EN 10204 3.1 certificates; weld log and maps
Calibration
Instruments traceable to national standards; out-of-tolerance results reviewed for impact
Calibration register; as-found and as-left certificates
Internal audit and management review
Each process audited by someone independent of it; results and CAPA status reviewed by management
Audit reports; management review minutes

blocks.h: How a defect is found, held and closed

items.d: Whoever finds it tags and segregates the item or stops the work, and raises an NCR.
Aquemi quality decides: reject, rework or accept as is. Accept as is, or a repair outside an approved document, needs your approval.
A rejected product-contact weld is cut out, not ground or re-fused; its replacement gets a new weld number.
For repeat, systemic or client-reported nonconformances we find the cause, change the procedure, training, supplier or equipment, and check other work at risk.
Evidence after an agreed period that the action worked, signed before the CAPA closes.
Your turnover package logs every NCR. One found after shipment that could affect your system reaches you within [NCR notice after shipment, working days].

blocks.h: What we require from our suppliers
blocks.intro: Each approved supplier is reviewed every [supplier review interval, months]. A supplier with an open CAPA is not used for your order until it closes.

316L to ASME BPE with an EN 10204 3.1 certificate per heat; a type 2.2 report is not accepted
Heat marking checked against the certificate; [PMI by X-ray fluorescence, standard or option]

USP <88> Class VI and FDA 21 CFR 177.2600, certificate per compound and grade
Compound and grade checked; like-for-like replacement only
Membranes, electrodeionization (EDI) and resin
Manufacturer's certificates with serial or lot numbers
Serial and lot numbers recorded at receipt and installation
Electropolishing
SF4: Ra ≤ 0.38 µm (15 µin) to ASME BPE; [in-house or named subcontractor]
Profilometer Ra readings at receipt; certificate per component
Passivation

Certificate checked for chemistry, temperature, contact time and verification test
Pressure vessels and control panels
ASME VIII Div. 1 vessels with a Canadian registration number (CRN) under CSA B51; CSA C22.2 No. 286 or UL 508A panels
Data reports reviewed; panel label checked

blocks.h: Questions quality and procurement teams ask

items.a: [ISO 9001 status, registrar and expiry]. Either way, your supplier qualification can test the system itself: the processes on this page, the records they leave and a sample traced end to end at an audit.

items.q: Can we audit you before we order?
items.a: Yes, and we prefer it: an audit before award settles questions that would otherwise reach your installation qualification (IQ). Remote, or on site at [shop location, city and province] with [on-site audit notice, working days] notice. Cost before order: [supplier audit before order, free or charged].

items.q: What is in the questionnaire pack?
items.a: Our supplier questionnaire (or yours), procedure list, certificates we hold, quality organization chart, redacted sample records (an NCR with its CAPA, a change request, a calibration certificate), critical supply categories, insurance certificates with [liability limits, general and professional], safety programme and workers' compensation clearance. Quality manual and supplier names: [shared openly or under NDA].

items.q: Will you sign our quality agreement?
items.a: Send it with the request for proposal and we mark it up with the quote. We look first at change notification, audit rights, subcontracting, record retention and how fast we tell you about a nonconformance. Mark-up returned within [quality agreement mark-up turnaround, working days].

items.q: Will you tell us before changing a material or design?
items.a: Before order, a change to a document you approved goes to you for approval before it is made. After handover, a change to your system runs through your change control, with our impact assessment (EU GMP Annex 15, section 11). Spare parts are like for like; anything else is notified before supply.

items.q: Do you audit your own subcontractors?
items.a: Every supplier of product-contact material and special processes, such as electropolishing and passivation, is approved before use and reviewed every [supplier review interval, months]. On-site subcontractor audits: [on-site subcontractor audits, how often]. Their certificates reach you as the issuer sent them, never retyped.

[role that releases to ship, and its independence]. A system does not leave the shop with an open NCR on a product-contact item unless you have approved the disposition. Open items go on the FAT punch list with an owner and a date.

items.q: How long do you keep quality records?
items.a: Project quality records, including NCRs, change requests and calibration certificates, for [quality record retention, years], and a copy of each turnover package for the period stated on the documentation page. Your site's own retention rules apply to your master copy.
